div.span:
• AI evidence enters only as quote verified facts and only through rules.
• Approval status and clinical review status are tracked separately.
• Rule limits: depth 8, 64 leaves, 80 rules per version.
• A rule regression suite replays test cases through the engine with no database and no model.
